items.question: Which further feminine forms are listed alongside the owl-woman and peacock-woman?
premises: The verse continues an enumeration of feminine forms.
It names owl-woman and peacock-woman among the forms.
It also names sarari-woman and gūlī-woman among the forms.
items.inference: The list continues with owl-woman, peacock-woman, sarari-woman, and gūlī-woman.
uncertainties: The exact doctrinal referent of each feminine form is not specified by this verse alone.
items.plain_english: Owl-woman, peacock-woman, or indeed sarari-woman, or gūlī-woman, likewise.
